I function better when I have clarity, and Aditi always ensure that I have a more clear picture of my health status with every visit. It has been more than 6 months and I have seen the results of being consistent with her.
She has a holistic approach towards your diet, listens patiently to your concerns, and incorporates your beliefs and likes with regards to food. I appreciate her guidance and look forward to continued engagement.

featured_reviews.name: Sweta Shah
featured_reviews.review_text: I was continuous facing gut issues which was affecting my day to day life alongwith it my sports performance. It was than when I came across Nutritionist Aditi Prabhu. She helped me to figure out reasons for my gut issues, how to manage it with proper food. She gave me a proper meal plan which helped me to overcome my gut problems. She also helped me to know how my emotions affect my gut. Slowly and steadily I am gaining my gut strength back, it might be a long journey but I know she will help me through it. Eventually, it will lead to improved emotions, improved gut and improved sports performance.

featured_reviews.name: Deepali Masurkar
featured_reviews.review_text:
I met Aditi for my husband's diet concerns and weight loss due to  some health issues.  We are having a very positive experience with Aditi, as she listened to each and every small thing, queries  and concerns.

In the last 6 months,  she provided  proper guidance about what to do or how to change the lifestyle to improve the gut health.

I have noticed improvement in my husband's overall health and especially in his gut health which is helping  him to gain the weight gradually, with her positive approach, support and guidance.

Aditi helped us  to accept a healthy lifestyle with very easy steps and doing small  necessary changes in our daily routine  with healthy habits to resolve the dietary concerns.

We are  grateful and  highly recommend Aditi !

featured_reviews.name: Ria Soni
featured_reviews.review_text: My journey with Aditi, has been really positive and comforting. She helped me understand my body better and guided me on how to improve it in a healthy and sustainable way. What I appreciate the most is that she cares not only about physical health but also about mental and emotional well-being. Talking to her feels like speaking with a more experienced woman who truly listens and supports you—almost like a therapist. Her empathetic and encouraging approach made this journey very meaningful for me.

featured_reviews.name: Seher S
featured_reviews.review_text:
Aditi - How much shall I say :).

Working with her has been an incredibly grounding experience. She is calm, focused, and truly attentive — the kind of nutritionist who doesn’t just give you a plan, but actually walks the journey with you. Through all my chaos, she was patient, supportive, and consistently brought me back on track with so much mindfulness.

She went out of her way to share the right information, help me understand my patterns, and guide me gently without pressure. Her approach is thoughtful, empathetic, and genuinely invested in your well-being.

I’m deeply grateful for her guidance — she made the process feel possible, manageable, and humane.
Thank you Aditi

featured_reviews.name: Harshal Jade
featured_reviews.review_text:
I came to Aditi Prabhu mam, struggling with IBS and gut-related issues, and after three months, I can say it has been a life-changing experience. What sets her apart is the understanding that health doesn't happen in a vacuum.
As a new parent dealing with sleep deprivation and stress, I expected a rigid plan that I’d struggle to follow. Instead, I received a compassionate, flexible roadmap that focused on consistency over perfection. They helped me navigate seasonal triggers and taught me how nervous system regulation—like simple breathwork—is just as vital for gut health as the food on my plate. I’m walking away not just with better digestion, but with a much healthier mindset toward self-care. Highly recommended for anyone looking for a truly holistic and empathetic expert!"

featured_reviews.name: Sanmadi K R
featured_reviews.review_text: Aditi mam was very attentive to my lifestyle and needs. All her suggestions and recommendations were affordable and practical changes that doesn't need excruciating will power to follow. I enjoy and eat what I love in portions that suit me without guilt now. She also kept checking on me on how does new diet changes affected my mood, gut periodically

featured_reviews.name: Anil Menon
featured_reviews.review_text: Chetna has been very helpful in guiding me with my diet and nutrition. With her correct guidance I could lose weight and manage my diabetes without starving myself. Following her meal plan has helped me in maintaining a healthy lifestyle.

featured_reviews.name: Sanjeev Kumar
featured_reviews.review_text:
I started my fitness and wellness journey at 86 kg, and today I’m proud to say I’m around 77–78 kg. Beyond just the number on the scale, what truly stands out is the holistic improvement in my health and lifestyle.

With her expert guidance, I learned how to make mindful choices- from balanced diet plans and portion control to regular exercise and maintaining consistency. She didn’t just provide a “diet plan”; she helped me understand how my body responds to different foods and how to make sustainable changes that fit my routine.

One of the most rewarding parts of this journey has been the visible improvement in my blood parameters. My HDL (good cholesterol) levels have gone up, and my LDL (bad cholesterol) levels have significantly reduced- clear proof of the positive internal changes this journey has brought.

I’m extremely grateful for her constant support, motivation, and scientific approach. This experience has not only helped me lose weight but also build a healthier relationship with food and fitness. Highly recommend her to anyone looking to make a real, long-term difference in their health!

featured_reviews.name: Anushree Mane
featured_reviews.review_text:
So last year I was wanting a loose around 7-8 kgs and hence decided to take up help professionally and went to Chetna for her amazing diet plans. Chetna Soni is a perfect nutritionist & dietician who gives diet just according to our concerns and health issues. Diet charts resonates with our household food and that’s sustainable for me. Nothing too fancy and perfect to loose weight and feels light on stomach too. Her constant motivation keeps you going.
Highly recommend her for her diet plans.

featured_reviews.name: Varun Nair
featured_reviews.review_text: I was diagnosed with high triglycerides and cholesterol primarily due to my lifestyle. I had set a goal to improve my health through diet and exercise. Chetna Soni created a customized diet plan based on my food habits by making small tweaks to what I eat and focus on portion control. She also explained the science behind how meals are composed and how our body absorbs nutrition from several sources. One of the toughest part of any diet is to remain consistent; we are used to being disciplined in the initial weeks and losing track later as things fall into routine. Chetna kept regular follow-ups to ensure we continue to focus on diet and would make small changes every week to make it interesting. I lost 5 kgs in the first two weeks and continue to maintain my weight thereafter. My cholesterol and triglycerides have come back to normal level. I highly recommend Chetna for anyone serious about improving their diet and maintaining a healthy lifestyle.

featured_reviews.name: Debarati Driver
featured_reviews.review_text: Am very lucky to be having Chetna as my nutrition consultant. Chetna understands the needs of a client and the solutions she gives is easy to follow and sustain. I lost 8 kgs in 4 months and feel more healthy and energetic than before. Her diet plans are simple and easy to follow even when we are cooking for the family. She is available, always, to guide and share tips to manage our daily food intakes. I would recommend her to anyone who needs practical, easy to follow diets. Thank you Chetna for making me realise that if I want to, it is not difficult to reach our health goals and maintain them too.

featured_reviews.name: Amritkala Shetty
featured_reviews.review_text: I was diagnosed with H.Pylori. I was looking for a dietician after my medication. I was introduced to Chetna Soni and she really helped me with my gut and digestion issues within 3 months of proper guidance and took my weekly updates. Now I have a healthier gut thanks to her. I would totally recommend her as many of my friends have also benefited by your guidance . Thank you Chetna Soni,🙏

featured_reviews.name: Priyamm Deka
featured_reviews.review_text: Chetna ma'am is the best nutritionist that you could choose. What I really liked about her was that she doesn't force you to make a huge change to your diet but gives makes a diet plan around your preferences and schedule. She is very result oriented and helped me lose more that 5+ kgs. Was helpful that she was always available on chat and I was even able to consult with her on healthier grocery options. Overall I think she goes above and beyond and I would really recommend as her services and have recommended her to my friends and family as well

featured_reviews.name: Kejal Gala
featured_reviews.review_text:
Dear Chetna mam,

I just wanted to take a moment to express my heartfelt gratitude for your guidance and support on my weight loss journey. Your expertise, encouragement, and personalized approach made all the difference in helping me achieve a healthier lifestyle. I truly appreciate how understanding you are and how you simplify everything, making it easy to follow a diet without feeling overwhelmed. Your simple yet effective meal plans have made this journey so much smoother and more sustainable.

Losing this weight has been life-changing, and I couldn’t have done it without your invaluable advice and motivation. Thank you for being such a wonderful mentor in this journey to better health.
